caption: The drawing features two ornate wall-mounted objects, each shown from both a front and a side view, depicted in colored pencil or watercolor on a plain, off-white background. The object at the top right has a decorative, vertically elongated backplate with gold and brown ornamentation and a large, central red circular element, along with a small knob or button below it. The matching side view to the upper left shows the projection of this object from the wall, with a curved, metallic arm and round face. The object at the bottom left has a similar elongated, symmetrical backplate with intricate gold detailing and a central circular portrait of a person's profile, primarily in sepia tones. The side view to the bottom right displays this object’s depth and mounting, with the hardware and backplate extending outward from the wall. The entire composition is rendered realistically with attention to the metallic luster and decorative designs in gold, bronze, and red hues. The artist’s name, Dana Bartlett, appears in small letters at the bottom right corner.
title: Brackets
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
